g.text: Data model: the Parquet tables and how image_id links them

text.tspan: Each table is <name>.parquet in its directory; rejects.parquet sits in data/catalog,
data/processed and data/features. Every table is validated against its pyarrow contract
before it is written; columns are non-null unless marked nullable. image_id is the sha256
of the image bytes. features has 119 finite columns: fo_* (first order), har_* (Haralick),
tas_* (TAS), zer_* (Zernike) and lbp_* (LBP). splits holds only the catalog images that
have features. eval holds the predictions rows, with source from splits and y_pred at
